name: Timeless Strike
description: A landed attack immediately triggers another one, which can chain again in turn.
details: Chained attacks deal %damage_multiplier:pct%% of their normal damage.
Each chained hit adds %duration% turn to a single stun on the target.

upgrade.summary: The first chained attack is rolled a second time if it misses.
details: Chained attacks deal %damage_multiplier:pct%% of their normal damage.
Each chained hit adds %duration% turn to a single stun on the target.
A chain that dies on its first swing gets %rerolls% more roll to keep itself going. Later links in the chain do not.
